description: Space, serenity, and complete freedom with no city taxes on this expansive, tree-lined acre. Newly refinished hardwood floors and fresh neutral paint flow throughout the bright layout, anchored by a two-story family room. The chef's kitchen features new quartz countertops and newer stainless steel appliances, with a dining room and sunny breakfast area for casual or formal dining. The first-floor primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet and a fully renovated bath with a freestanding tub and dual vanities. Upstairs offers three spacious bedrooms plus a versatile flex room ideal for a home office, gym, or playroom, along with a private en-suite guest bedroom. Out back, relax on the large screened porch or deck under a pergola, surrounded by a sprawling, wooded acre lot. An epoxy-finished garage floor and walk-in storage round out this well-located home, convenient to Highway 540, Durham, Wake Forest, and Raleigh.
